doc.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024

title: Bass line guessing game and 1960s listening
summary: Rowe scats bass lines; Friesen did not know pop hits and says he listened to Ayler, Coltrane, Miles and Ravi Shankar, and recognizes Paul Chambers with Miles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening
